card.text: The Ring Nebula is a planetary nebula about 790 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110, Table A.1, PN G063.1+13.9: distance 790 pc (764 to 818) from the Gaia EDR3 parallax of its central star
Wikipedia, "Ring Nebula"
sources.quote: The Ring Nebula is a planetary nebula in the northern constellation of Lyra, about mid-way between the prominent stars Beta and Gamma Lyrae.

introduction.text: ESA/Hubble's photograph of it lies here on the walls its spectra give: a shell 0.34 pc across and a lobe through its opening, pointed almost at the Sun.

sources.label: ESA/Hubble heic1310a: NASA, ESA, and C. Robert O'Dell (Vanderbilt University)

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Ring Nebula"
sources.quote: It is also catalogued as Messier 57, M57 and NGC 6720.

sources.label: O'Dell et al. (2013), AJ 145, 92: Studies of NGC 6720 with calibrated HST/WFC3 emission-line filter images. I. Structure and evolution
